GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and shifted in. Near the 1100m, checked from heels. Carried wider from the 700m. Checked near the 500m when tightened for room.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly bumping heavily. Held up passing the 400m.
